name: Zero Pulses
description: No marbles dropped: the register must not move.

name: Single Pulse
description: One marble from zero: register becomes 1.

name: Full Period Returns Home
description: Exactly 8 pulses from 0 must return to 0, wrapping once.

name: Odd Starting Value
description: Starting mid-register, wraps exactly at the boundary.

name: Starting At Maximum
description: One pulse from the max value (111) must wrap immediately to 0.

name: Multiple Wraps
description: 20 pulses from 2 crosses the wrap boundary twice; final value 6.

name: Short Run, No Wrap
description: A run that stays entirely below the ceiling should report zero wraps.

name: Manual Binary Cross-Check
description: Trace must equal manual binary counting 001,010,011,100,101 read as decimals.
